description: FORGE 2.0 Phase 0 pilot, revision of 0.1.0 (benchmarks/pilot-v0, kept unchanged). Same 30 task IDs, categories, specification levels and splits; 16 tasks revised (version 2) so that each states a checkable content or minimum requirement and no task can be fully passed by a trivial answer such as 'ok'. Deterministic L0 checks only; for harness validation and diagnostics, not evidence of prompt quality.
